description: This file defines the CommonWorkers utility class, providing methods for retrieving geographical data such as country and state lists, as well as associated regions, from the OFBiz entity system. It includes methods for querying geographies, handling default selections, and recursive relation checks.

classes.name: CommonWorkers
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for geographical data retrieval and hierarchy checks within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getCountryList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of countries, prioritizing the default country, and including available countries based on configuration.

methods.name: getStateList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of states, provinces, territories, and municipalities.

methods.name: getAssociatedStateList
methods.description: Returns a list of regional geographies associated with a given country, including recursive group memberships.

methods.name: hasParentType
methods.description: Checks if a given entity type has a specified parent type in its hierarchy; deprecated in favor of EntityTypeUtil method.
